item.title: [The MAD Podcast with Matt Turck] AI Could Take Over in 2029. Is It Already Too Late? | Ryan Greenblatt
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:21 I think that the AI company CEOs understand that they're on the path of building wildly smarter than human systems, like super intelligent AI systems. They understand that we don't really have a, like, clear thought through plan for how to manage the risks from that. I wouldn't say superintelligence is bad. I would say it's dangerous. It seems pretty likely that you end up with AI takeover as a result of building superintelligence.
